finding.summary: Preflight requires a 64-character manifest_digest but does not check the lowercase-hex alphabet required by verifyRetainedRelease. A malformed 64-character value can therefore pass scalar preflight and cause the retained files payload to be selected before the verifier rejects it. Folder syntax and retained path dot-segment checks are also deferred to the verifier; those may be included if consistent with preserving compatibility.
finding.suggested_resolution: Add cheap database scalar boolean checks for the known manifest digest alphabet (and assess folder/path syntax checks against historical accepted valid rows) so malformed known identity metadata is rejected before payload selection.
finding.limitations: Static preliminary source review only. No tests/builds/scans/lifecycle run. Exact-head review remains pending. Does not assert cryptographic manifest verification can be completed before payload materialization.
